args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. Confirmed the rollback completed (`status: rolled_out`) and the service is now **healthy** in all regions with error rate back to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; on-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so v2.3.1 should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt.
